output.title: Test infrastructure change; does not affect runtime
output.content: This change modifies cert-manager's internal E2E test suite and test infrastructure (Pebble ACME server), not the runtime application. The operator is upgrading the cert-manager application itself for deployment in their environment, which contains cert-manager v1.17.0 with ACME capabilities. Test suite changes do not reach deployed environments and do not affect the behavior of cert-manager v1.18.0 running in this cluster.
